mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, triggering a flight to safety and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates broad consumer demand weakness, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO growth < 1.0% annualized) signals an impending economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings growth and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 1.0% in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production growth (INDPRO annualized growth < 0.5%) signals a manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth < 0.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that fuels wage inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 700.0 thousand units) signals a housing market correction, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 700.0 in early-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
